evidence.section: 3.3 Cold-rolled and annealed Mo10 alloy microstructure
evidence.quote: BFTEM images and corresponding SAED patterns in Fig. 5a-d demonstrate that the alloys retain a single-phase BCC structure after recrystallization.

attributes.morphology: large grains with L/D ratio greater than unity

evidence.quote: the as-cast alloys consist of large grains with an L/D ratio greater than unity, which is due to the cooling effect of the water-cooled copper crucible.

attributes.composition: Nb and Mo enriched; Zr abundant within grain; Ti relatively uniform

evidence.quote: Nb and Mo are enriched in the grain boundary regions, whereas, as illustrated in Fig. 1g2, Zr is abundant within the grain. In contrast, as shown in Fig. 1g1, Ti is relatively uniform.
